description: Wide/deep raked bow; length includes the decorative prow. Same approved V3 bow rake and 60-triangle prow as W1-r2, 25% wider deck, keel lowered to -2.75.
boundsNote: Measured 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): union of the module's FBX vertex bounds, converted to authoring axes by the measured Blender-reimport rotation (authoring.x=-measured.y, authoring.y=measured.x, authoring.z=measured.z). Max Z 3.52 matches Bow_W1's exactly (prow height unchanged per kit README).

sockets.notes: Measured 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation, Blender): Bow_W2/Hull_Shell.fbx sliced at the height datum Z 0 reaches X 8.45 -- IDENTICAL to Bow_W1's stem (also 8.45; at the deck, Z 1.76, both reach 9.42). The kit's README says the approved V3 bow rake and prow are retained unchanged, only the cross-section is wider/deeper; this measurement confirms the X-profile (rake) truly did not change, only Y (beam) and Z (keel) did. Not in Astra's manifest; confirm or supply.
Tip of the decorative prow; not a join.

visuals.notes: Optional decorative prow; shares the bow origin.

equipmentSlots.notes: Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint (art-staging/cannon-astra-v1: 1.22 wide x 2.18 long x 1.28 high), verified by WideHullValidation against this section's bounds and its crew passage (touches, does not overlap). CAVEAT: DeckSlot_0 and DeckSlot_1 on the SAME side overlap each other by 0.18 u in X if both carried a real cannon at once (pitch 2.0 u < the cannon's 2.18 u length); only one gun per side is offered (capacity.gunSlots below).

passages.notes: W2 has no authored crew passages (kit README); derived from W1-r2's passage rule scaled to the W2 deck (docs/WIDE-HULL-VALIDATION.md): |y| <= the deck-slot Y (4.35) minus half the real cannon's width (1.22/2=0.61) = 3.74, so sizeU.y = 7.48. X runs from the aft end (0) to X 4.59, the forward edge of the last deck-slot clearance (slot X 3.5 + half the real cannon's length 2.18/2=1.09) -- wider than W1-r2's 4.4 because the real cannon is longer than the placeholder footprint W1-r2 used. Height 3.4 u (1.7 m crew) unchanged.

hydrostatics.notes: Astra 2026-09-24 (art-staging/modular-hull-wide-v1/hydrostatics/Bow_W2.json): Hull_Shell only, upright level flotation.

lightship.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): today's W1-r2 Long lightship (31906.6 kg) x the W2/W1 Long hydrostatic-table volume-to-deck ratio (940.54 / 611.67 U^3 = 1.5377), split by this section's own table volume to the deck (264.41 / 940.54 U^3). See hull.stern.w2r1.v1's lightship.rule for why the volume ratio was chosen over the surface-area ratio.

holdCells.source: round(this section's table volume-to-deck (264.41 U^3) / W1-r2's volume-per-hold-cell (611.67/16=38.229 U^3))

berths.source: floor(W1-r2 bow's 2 berths x the W2/W1 deck-area ratio 11.60/9.28=1.25)

gunSlots.source: Both slots pass the real-cannon clearance/passage check (WideHullValidation); this is the same DeckSlot index W1-r2's bow designates, kept for consistency (no existing W2 ship to match a gun position to). DeckSlot_0 is left off to avoid the same-side adjacent-slot overlap noted on those slots.

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation), mirroring the W1-r2 A4 seeding: PROVISIONAL, tune freely; the shipyard sums whatever is here.
